# Iniyavan Mageshwaran - Senior Product Designer & Digital Marketer

> Official Website & Portfolio: https://iniyavandesign.github.io/

## Profile Summary
Iniyavan Mageshwaran is a Senior Product Designer and Digital Marketer with over 6 years of experience specializing in human-centric digital solutions, mobile & web UI/UX design, and performance marketing (Meta Ads & Google Ads).

## Core Specializations
- **Product & UX/UI Design**: Mobile Apps, Web Applications, User Research, Wireframing, Interactive Prototyping, Design Systems.
- **Digital Marketing & Paid Ads**: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Growth Marketing.

## Featured UX Case Studies
- [RescueFuel Case Study](https://iniyavandesign.github.io/rescue.html): Engineering certainty and rapid response in roadside emergency assistance.
- [PayMe Case Study](https://iniyavandesign.github.io/payme.html): Human-centric fintech payment experience.
- [BidChit Case Study](https://iniyavandesign.github.io/chitfund.html): Transparent digital chit fund platform design.
